role: ChunkProviderGenerate.provideChunk for one overworld chunk: seeds the provider rand from the chunk coords, runs the density pass, full-resolution biomes, surface pass, caves, ravines, then the Chunk constructor and generateSkylightMap.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
notes: Called from world.c chunk_backend_c (dimension 0 only, every call a world_chunk_request), which mallocs the chunk; that allocation is world.c's hazard, not this file's. test_worldgen.c checks the stages (terrain, surface, caves_pass, ravines_pass) individually rather than through provide_chunk; test_seedworld.c reaches provide_chunk through seedworld/world. struct chunkgen.owed marks a provider that owes world_insert_chunk's skipped generations; chunkgen_init clears it (lane suitestart, 2026-09-25). provide_chunk is chunkgen_raw then chunkgen_construct; genahead.c constructs a chunk generated elsewhere (the CUDA kernels) with chunkgen_construct (lane/gpugen).
